title: Solve single-particle wavefunctions
action: Implement the electron and positron surface barrier potentials (smooth barrier formulas with shape parameter λ). Solve the time-independent Schrödinger equation for electrons and positrons in these potentials using inward Runge-Kutta integration with Whittaker-function asymptotic boundary conditions. For each required λ⁻¹ value (1.0, 1.2, …, 2.5) generate the electronic wavefunction and the positronic wavefunction for the fixed parameter cases (λ⁻¹ = 1.5 for the constant partner) needed by the subsequent matrix-element computation. Store the wavefunctions for later use.
description: Computes the electron and positron wavefunctions in the smooth surface barrier potentials required as input for the Ps formation matrix element.

title: Calculate Ps formation intensity for sensitivity study
action: For each λ⁻¹ value from 1.0 to 2.5 in steps of 0.2, compute the squared magnitude of the positronium formation matrix element |M|² using the LEED-type integral (without reciprocal-lattice sums) for three cases: (1) vary only electronic λ⁻¹, fix positronic λ⁻¹ = 1.5; (2) vary only positronic λ⁻¹, fix electronic λ⁻¹ = 1.5; (3) vary both together (equal values). Use electron energy level –0.375 hartree and incident positron kinetic energy 1.5 hartree. Evaluate the integral numerically using the wavefunctions obtained in the preceding step. Write one row per (λ⁻¹, case) with the column intensity as the computed |M|².
description: CSV file with computed |M|² values for the barrier parameter sweep under three variation conditions.
output_schema: CSV file with header: lambda_inv,case,intensity. lambda_inv is a numeric value (λ⁻¹), case is a string ('electron','positron','both'), intensity is the numeric |M|².
